method: Actual source callbacks evaluated in VM and actual Finance/Billing rendered through React SSR with in-memory localStorage. No browser, Firebase, credentials or API calls.

findings.trigger: Open Billing in two tabs. Change plan in A, then change plan in B without refreshing.
findings.impact: The first successful plan-change invoice is deleted from local history by the second tab. Both handlers show success. Pause/resume also serializes stale subscription state.
findings.scope: Normal local multi-tab workflow; no payment provider or Firestore involved.

findings.trigger: Subscription or payment-method localStorage already contains truncated JSON; open Billing.
findings.observed: loadStoredData returns fixture defaults; actual mount persistence effect immediately writes those defaults over the corrupt original.
findings.impact: Recoverable plan/invoice/payment-label bytes are lost and sample records replace them silently.
findings.limitation: Needs already damaged local cache; no ordinary input path generating malformed JSON established.

findings.trigger: Already malformed cache has valid JSON but wrong structure, e.g. {} for invoice array/subscription record or [null] for invoice array.
findings.impact: Finance/Billing crash during render, before a recoverable state can be shown. Unlike new HR/PO recovery, these modules still trust loadStoredData generic type.
findings.limitation: Requires wrong-shape saved cache; no ordinary form input generating this structure established.
